title: Build Local Assisted Review Workspace
objective: Build a localhost-only assisted review workspace over the immutable Task 203, 204 and 205 evidence for both accepted review targets.
moduleGoal: Make the existing 102-candidate visual and audio evidence operational for bounded human review, segmentation, persistence and export.
observableOutcome: A dependency-light local web workspace with controlled media serving, range audio, atomic local review persistence and selectable local export.
metricContribution: 2 targets and 102 candidates loaded; visual/audio availability, call segment counts, API/range/security checks, persistence/export roundtrips and zero upstream/media/replay/VOD/protected mutations or accesses.
remainingModuleGap: Mixed-VOD ASR remains only a temporal locator and draft; candidate selectivity and replay-video synchronization precision remain limited.
hardeningDeferred: No parser, detector, ranking, ASR, sync, frame extraction, diarization, real Craig, cloud, authentication, licensing, LLM or coaching work.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: expose multiple immutable provenance layers through a secure local HTTP workspace while keeping every human edit local and preventing arbitrary filesystem access.
executionContract.objective: Build the smallest complete local interface that makes the accepted two-match review artifacts practical to operate.
technicalContext: Task 205 is Work-accepted at 1a0365a3a59596da267fbf3480adb5488034cb20 with mixed-VOD ASR useful only as locator and draft.
Tasks 203, 204 and 205 artifacts are immutable inputs; no replay, VOD, extraction or ASR rerun is required.
confirmedState: Task 204 contains exactly 102 review-attention candidates across review_match_001 and review_match_002.
Local frame/storyboard indexes and both Task 205 mixed WAV sources are available on this executor.
The bounded human ASR validation resolved the manual-validation blocker and established 43.75 percent usable rate.
branchEnvironment: Create and publish exactly one Task 206 commit.
allowedScope: Read compact Task 203/204/205 artifacts and their allowlisted local frame, storyboard, atlas, call-index and WAV evidence.
Write workspace code/tests/docs, five compact readiness artifacts and local-only review state/exports.
protectedAreas: Never open any .dem, original .mp4, replay_005 through replay_008 or arbitrary path supplied by an HTTP client.
Never modify upstream Task 202/203/204/205 evidence, parser packages, packages/ui, local source media or real human-review data.
expectedChanges: Isolated Node HTTP workspace, data model, atomic persistence, bounded export, static UI, schema, tests, compact readiness outputs, report and necessary coordination/navigation updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Both targets and all 102 immutable candidates load with chronological/priority navigation and review-state filters.
Allowlisted visual evidence and HTTP Range audio work with explicit graceful media gaps.
Synthetic review state, human segmentation and JSON/Markdown export roundtrip locally without gameplay conclusions.
Traversal/protected aliases are rejected and no upstream artifact or media is versioned or mutated.
requiredEvidence: Two-target/102-candidate loading, immutable fingerprints, visual/audio/call availability, atomic persistence/export roundtrip, HTTP endpoints, Range 206, traversal rejection, privacy audit and post-commit attestation.
commitPolicy: Create exactly one commit named Build local assisted review workspace.
Stage only authorized compact paths and publish main with a normal non-forced push.
stopConditions: Stop on missing Task 204 core inputs, base divergence, protected/replay/VOD access, upstream mutation, arbitrary path resolution, versioned real review/media or automatic gameplay interpretation.
Stop in VALIDATING and do not create Task 207 or start another module.
returnReportFormat: Resultado, O que passou a funcionar, Valor observável, Impacto no módulo, Limitação relevante, Próximo objetivo and Previsão operacional.

stopConditions: Never access replay bytes, original VODs or historical replay_005 through replay_008.
Never mutate accepted candidates/evidence or version real review state, media or gameplay interpretation.
